items.name: video.generate
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_media_facade.video_generate → quota hold → fal queue (webhook + poller) → R2
items.summary: Submit an asynchronous text-to-video or image-to-video job. The host validates parameters against the model catalogue, **pre-charges** the estimated CU, submits to the fal queue with a webhook, persists an `anna_media_jobs` row and returns a `jobId` within ~1s. Progress and the terminal result arrive as `media_job` SSE events; `video.getJob` is the authoritative state. Most apps should use the SDK sugar `anna.video.generateAwait()` which combines all of this.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

items.signature:
anna.video.generate(args: {prompt: string, imageUrl?: string, durationSec?: number, resolution?: string, aspectRatio?: string, generateAudio?: boolean, model?: string, clientTag?: string}, opts?: {timeoutMs?: number}) => Promise<{jobId: string, state: 'queued', estimatedCostCU: number, deadlineAt: string}>

anna.video.generateAwait(args, {onProgress?, signal?, timeoutMs?}) => Promise<JobView & {result: {url, refreshUrl(): Promise<string>, …}}>

params.name: prompt
params.summary: Natural-language description of the clip. Trimmed; empty → `VIDEO_INVALID_REQUEST`. Forwarded verbatim to the provider — provider / platform content moderation applies (`VIDEO_CONTENT_REJECTED`, not billed).

params.name: imageUrl
params.summary: Non-empty → **image-to-video** using this frame as the first frame. Must be `https` (R2 presigned URLs and `web.image_fetch` products are accepted); SSRF guard applies. `aspectRatio` is ignored in i2v (follows the image). Only models with `capabilities.imageToVideo` accept it.

params.name: durationSec
params.summary: Clip length in seconds. Must satisfy the model's `capabilities.duration` (an enum `values[]` or a `{min,max}` range) — read it from `llm.catalog`. Billing uses `max(durationSec, pricing.minBilledSeconds)`.

params.name: resolution
params.summary: Must be in `capabilities.resolutions` (lower-case, e.g. `480p` / `768p` / `1080p`). Models without a resolution knob (Kling) require this to be **omitted**.

params.name: aspectRatio
params.summary: Must be in `capabilities.aspectRatios` (e.g. `16:9`, `9:16`, `1:1`). Ignored for image-to-video.

params.name: generateAudio
params.summary: Ask the model to synthesize a soundtrack. Only accepted when `capabilities.audio` is true; may change the per-second price (Kling `cuPerSecondAudioOn`).

params.name: model
params.summary: Optional model hint (`modelName` from `llm.catalog`). Defaults to the user's `modelPreferences.video_gen`, then the catalogue default. Unknown → `VIDEO_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE`.

params.name: clientTag
params.summary: Free-form correlation tag (≤120 chars) echoed in `getJob` / `listJobs` / `media_job`; filter `listJobs` by it. Same semantics as `tools.invokeAsync` clientTag.

returns.type: { jobId: string, state: 'queued', estimatedCostCU: number, deadlineAt: string }
returns.desc: `jobId` is the `vjob_…` handle for every other call. `estimatedCostCU` is the amount **held** from the user's quota (shown to the user; settled or refunded at the terminal state). `deadlineAt` is the server-side wall clock after which the job is failed and refunded.

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.video` does not list this method, or the user's `media_grant.video.enabled` is off for this App.

errors.name: APP_QUOTA_EXCEEDED
errors.desc: CU pre-charge failed — the user's plan quota is exhausted (HTTP 429 on the HTTP surface). No platform-side daily or concurrency cap exists; this is the only gate.

errors.name: VIDEO_INVALID_REQUEST
errors.desc: Parameter outside the model's catalogue space (duration / resolution / aspectRatio / prompt too long / bad `imageUrl` / `clientTag` > 120 chars). `data.allowed` echoes the full allowed space for the resolved model.

errors.name: VIDEO_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE
errors.desc: No active text-to-video model is routable, or the `model` hint does not exist / is not allowed for the user.

errors.name: VIDEO_PROVIDER_ERROR
errors.desc: fal submit failed (message carries the first 200 chars of the provider error). The CU hold is refunded immediately.

errors.name: VIDEO_CONTENT_REJECTED
errors.desc: Platform or provider content moderation rejected the prompt / image. Not billed.

billing.model: pre-charge on submit → settle on `succeeded` → full refund on `failed` / cancelled-while-queued; cancelling a `running` job does not refund
billing.pricing: catalogue `pricing`: per-second by resolution (MiniMax / Seedance, `minBilledSeconds`) or flat / audio-on (Kling); i2v may add a reference-image surcharge. Shown in CU via `llm.catalog`.

limitations: Asynchronous only — there is no blocking `generate` on the wire; `generateAwait` is SDK-side sugar (events + adaptive `getJob` polling).

Result URLs expire in ~30 min (`expiresIn`). Re-`getJob` to re-sign; for durable storage fetch the bytes and use `upload.negotiate`/`confirm` (counts toward App storage). Terminal objects are deleted after 7 days.
Parameters are validated against the **resolved model's** catalogue entry — always read `llm.catalog({serviceType:'video_gen'})` first instead of hard-coding durations / resolutions.
CSP: `media-src` in your bundle must allow the host's R2 hostname (`https:`) to play `result.url` in a `<video>` element.

items.name: video.getJob
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_media_facade.video_get_job → anna_media_jobs (re-signs result URL)
items.summary: Return the authoritative view of one job owned by this user + App. While running it carries `progress {seq, phase, queuePosition}`; on `succeeded` it carries `result {url, mimeType, durationSec, width, height, seed, expiresIn}` and `billedCostCU`. Calling `getJob` after the URL expired **re-signs** a fresh presigned URL — this is the recovery path for 403s on playback.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

params.name: jobId
params.summary: `vjob_…` returned by `generate`. Jobs belonging to another user / App → `VIDEO_JOB_NOT_FOUND`.

returns.type: JobView = { jobId, state: 'queued'|'running'|'succeeded'|'failed'|'cancelled', clientTag?, progress?: {seq, phase, queuePosition}, request: {prompt, imageUrl?, durationSec, resolution?, aspectRatio?, generateAudio?, model}, result?: {url, mimeType, durationSec, width, height, seed, expiresIn}, error?: {code, message}, estimatedCostCU, billedCostCU?, createdAt, deadlineAt }
returns.desc: `progress.seq` is the same monotonic counter used by `media_job` events. `result` only on `succeeded`; `error` only on `failed`. Job rows are retained 30 days for billing even after the media object is cleaned up (then `result.url` is absent).

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.video` does not list this method, or the user's `media_grant.video.enabled` is off for this App.

errors.name: VIDEO_JOB_NOT_FOUND
errors.desc: Unknown `jobId`, or the job belongs to a different user / App.

limitations: Polling is a fallback, not the primary channel — subscribe to `media_job` events (or use `generateAwait`) and poll adaptively.
`result.url` from an older `getJob` or event may already be expired; always treat a 403 as 'call getJob again'.

items.name: video.cancelJob
items.direction: Bundle (iframe) → Host RPC → app_media_facade.video_cancel_job → fal cancel → quota refund (queued only)
items.summary: Cancel a non-terminal job. **Queued** jobs are cancelled with a **full refund** of the CU hold. **Running** jobs attempt a provider-side cancel; if the provider is already rendering, the call returns `{state:'running', cancelPending:false}` and nothing is refunded (compute was consumed).

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

items.signature: anna.video.cancelJob(args: {jobId: string}, opts?: {timeoutMs?: number}) => Promise<{jobId, state: 'cancelled', refunded: true} | {jobId, state: 'running', cancelPending: false}>

returns.type: { jobId, state: 'cancelled', refunded: true } | { jobId, state: 'running', cancelPending: false }
returns.desc: Check `state` — a `running` echo means the cancel did not take effect; the job will still reach a terminal state and bill normally.

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.video` does not list this method, or the user's `media_grant.video.enabled` is off for this App.

errors.name: VIDEO_JOB_NOT_FOUND
errors.desc: Unknown `jobId` or not owned by this user / App.

limitations: Refund is all-or-nothing: no partial refund for running jobs.

items.name: video.listJobs
items.summary: Cursor-paginated history of this App's jobs for the current user — the reload-recovery entry point (after an iframe reload, list `running` / `queued` jobs and resubscribe). Filter by `state` and/or `clientTag`.

wire.auth: Handled by the host page — the bundle never sees the token. Transport (`POST /api/v1/anna-apps/runtime/rpc`, `X-Anna-App-Token`, envelope wrapping) is described once in the section overview; the equivalent HTTP endpoints under `/api/v1/copilot/app/...` accept an `app_session_token`.

items.signature: anna.video.listJobs(args?: {state?: string, clientTag?: string, limit?: number, cursor?: string}, opts?: {timeoutMs?: number}) => Promise<{jobs: JobView[], nextCursor?: string}>

params.name: clientTag
params.summary: Exact-match filter on the tag set at `generate`.

params.name: cursor
params.summary: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `nextCursor`. Malformed → `VIDEO_INVALID_REQUEST`.

returns.desc: Newest first. `JobView` is the same shape as `getJob` (URLs re-signed).

errors.name: APP_NOT_GRANTED
errors.desc: manifest `ui.host_api.video` does not list this method, or the user's `media_grant.video.enabled` is off for this App.

errors.name: VIDEO_INVALID_REQUEST
errors.desc: Parameter outside the model's catalogue space (duration / resolution / aspectRatio / prompt too long / bad `imageUrl` / `clientTag` > 120 chars). `data.allowed` echoes the full allowed space for the resolved model.

limitations: Job rows are kept 30 days; media objects 7 days — older `succeeded` jobs may have no `result.url`.
